name: Orange Degreaser

features.text: Quickly removes oil, grease, tar, brake dust and road film.

description: An acid-free, non-corrosive, concentrated degreaser that removes dirt, grease, and grime. This citrus, oil-based degreaser can be used on car bodies, engines, floors, walls, carpeting, vinyl, tires, and wheels.
application: Light-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:15 with water. Medium-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:6 with water. Heavy-Duty Cleaning: dilute 1:3 with water. 1) Dilute with water and apply with spray bottle or sponge. 2) Spray or wipe diluted solution on surface to be cleaned. 3) If needed, scrub surface with a brush. 4) Rinse surface with clean water. Do not allow product to dry on surface.
